provenance_notes: No runtime session ID/receipt reference exposed; no model probing. Notes and asset bindings retained in each paper. Completed records includes reviewed2 plus needs_evidence1; dispositions are mutually exclusive.

validation.scope: Worker own-seat structural, arithmetic and citation-string checks only; not a machine proof of semantic/scientific correctness or controller two-seat/aggregate acceptance.

papers.summary: Promising retained context-memory results with narrow OOD transfer; hidden static rules and blocker information prevent a point score.
Tool-aligned training repairs harmful naive planner wrapping; broad mechanism and cost claims exceed the local evidence.
Inspectable UAV integration with a local external gate; quantitative safety, reliability and efficiency claims remain untested.

items: Complete static per-task prompt instances and reference/decision rules (author-elided Appendices F,H,I).
Whether simulator blocker/dependency features are available equally to baselines and how they are derived without privileged ground-truth graph access.
Reconcile claims of no hypothesis conditioning before verification with explicit active-hypothesis prompt injection; specify action-level falsification/admission protocol.

blockers.effect: X and E.causality unknown; raw/display score null. Missing actual static prompts and information-privilege evidence must be shared/fixed for both seats before any new attempt.

notes: All scores are calibration-dev judgments under draft_uncalibrated weights, not frozen production scores or selected Reel decisions.
